top_signals.title: Brazil Markets Rally as Trabuco Pick Soothes Fiscal Fears
top_signals.summary: Brazilian markets rallied after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva picked one of the nation’s most prominent bankers to be his finance minister, easing the worries about his economic policies that triggered a deep selloff after his surprise re-election last month.
